# Каталог: .github/workflows/

## Назначение
GitHub Actions pipelines для merge/release gate по этапам продукта.

## Файлы

### scale-adapters.yml
- Stage 5 (scale-adapters): docs-api-gate, frontend/backend tests, build, windows-package, evidence-gate.

### yearly-db-archive.yml
- Stage 6 (годовые БД / архив), отдельно от stage 5:
  - `frontend-tests` — `npm test` + `test:stage6-frontend`
  - `backend-tests` — полный pytest + `test:stage6-backend`
  - `build` — `npm run build`
  - `production-smoke` — `npm start` + smoke `active` / `archive` / `fail-retry` / `parallel-lock`
  - `windows-package` — `build:win:exe` + проверка layout `BD/`/`backup/`/`logs/` вне `_MEIPASS`
  - `evidence-gate` — evidence reports, acceptance без FAIL, `release-checklist.md`

### photo-capture.yml
- Stage 7 (фотофиксация / dual packaging), отдельно от stage 5/6:
  - `frontend-tests` — `npm test` + `test:stage7-frontend`
  - `backend-tests` — полный pytest + `test:stage7-backend`
  - `build` — `npm run build`
  - `import-smoke-basic` — `smoke:photo-basic-import` на `requirements.txt` (без OpenCV)
  - `import-smoke-full` — `smoke:photo-full-import` на `requirements-full.txt` (с OpenCV)
  - `windows-package` — basic + full exe, layout `BD/`/`backup/`/`logs/`/`Photo/` вне `_MEIPASS`
  - `evidence-gate` — release-gate + packaging tokens + deploy docs + secrets checklist

## Зависимости
- `package.json` — stage-6/7 wrapper scripts (`test:stage6*`, `smoke:stage6*`, `test:stage7*`, `smoke:photo*`)
- `docs/reports/yearly-db-archive/` — evidence и release checklist stage 6
- `docs/reports/photo-capture/` — evidence и release checklist stage 7
- `docs/photo-capture-deploy.md` — runbook stage 7
- `scripts/smoke_yearly_archive.py`, `scripts/smoke_photo_capture.py` — production-like smoke
- `installer/build.ps1` — Windows packaging + storage layout asserts
